message: No detected input validation: The uploaded CSV is read directly with pd.read_csv() without any schema checks, dtype assertions, column presence checks, or value-range guards.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is acquired only via a user-uploaded file through Streamlit's file_uploader; no remote URLs or cloud sources are used, and no checksum or integrity verification is performed on the upload.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is applied to the training data at any point in the preparation pipeline.

No detected model integrity verification: No pretrained weights or serialized models are loaded; models are instantiated fresh from scikit-learn/xgboost constructors with no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revisions.
No detected label distribution validation: The code performs no checks on label distribution, class balance, or anomalous training samples before fitting the model.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training flow.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any stress-testing mechanisms are present in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although a train/test split is performed, the test set is not cryptographically isolated or hashed, and there is no evidence of multiple independent metric reporting or signed evaluation data to prevent tampering.
No detected input sanitization: The uploaded CSV is read directly into a DataFrame and passed to the model without any shape, type, range, or schema validation checks.
No detected output bounds checks: Model predictions are used and displayed without any NaN guards, range checks, or sanity bounds on the output values.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses tabular regression models (XGBoost, RandomForest, Lasso), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
